sign: Top station of the Gilt Funicular. The Gilt House welcomes you. The Gilt House is watching you.
North: the White Stair to Gildcrest. East: the Mirror Flats.

lines: Station Nurse Ambre: Rest up. The air is thin up here, and so is the patience of the people who own it.
Kiosk Keeper Lumen Doss: Water, tonics, postcards of the view. The view itself is not for sale. Yet.

lines: Porter Anselm: I carry trunks up from the station. Nobody tips. They just say the view is payment.
Painter Cosima: I paint the horizon every evening. The Gilt House buys every one, then burns them. They like to own the sunset.
Old Hesper: Eighty years on this ledge. I've seen three funiculars and four Gilt patriarchs fall. Only the funiculars were accidents.
Fixer Oriel Vane waits at the top station with tea and a contract. The Gilt House wants the four Rifts sealed before the summer feast.
Oriel Vane: Four Rifts, one summer feast, one very generous family. Sign here, here and here. The last one is in case you die.
Oriel Vane: Starwell first. The Orrery Rift is north of town. Drink your tea, it's going cold.
The funicular stopped halfway on purpose. The brakeman counted your team and sent the list ahead, one copy per family.
Isaura sold your horoscope to the Gilt House: route, weak spots and the day you would arrive. All of it came true.
Oriel Vane: Paleshore next. The Salt Rift. Mind the mirror, it lies better than I do.
Your fixer Oriel has worked for Halloran all along. The tea was weak on purpose, so you would sleep through the ambush.
Oriel Vane: ...Yes. That was me. Halloran paid better than tea. Go to Whitecairn. I'll be there. Probably.
Halloran cuts Oriel loose to buy his own way out. She turns up at Whitecairn with a cairn stone and an apology. Only one of them is heavy.
Oriel Vane: Gildcrest. The feast. Aurek is waiting. So is everyone who wants him dead. Bring a spare fork.
Brakeman Fidel: The Gilt Funicular, down to the Greyreach and back. The brakes are new. The cable is a family heirloom.

white_stair: Nine hundred steps of white stone, straight up to Gildcrest. Counted every morning.

lines: Matron Elke: Lie down. The Gilt House pays for the bed. It also counts the hours you spend in it.
Tilde: Fidel checks the cable every morning. Then he comes home and checks his will.
Tilde: I am in it twice. Once as his wife, once as a witness.
Clerk Odalys: Souvenirs on the left, tonics on the right. The souvenirs outlive most of the buyers.

lines: Apprentice Jorin: Cosima paints the sunset, the House burns it, and I sweep up the ash. It is the only steady job in the arts.
